operator.name: VideoFileWriterOp
operator.description: FFmpeg-backed encoder operator. Consumes holoscan::Tensor frames (NHWC or NCHW; uint8 or float; RGB, BGR, or grayscale) and writes them to an .mp4 (or any libavformat-supported container) via libavcodec. Defaults to libx264 regardless of container; override via the writer's codec config entry.
